name: MoMA Teens-in-Residence
what_you_do: Meet weekly at MoMA with artists and museum staff. You do hands-on workshops, help plan public programs, lead gallery experiences, and write gallery text and audio. No art-making experience needed.
who_can_apply: New York City high school students in grade 10, 11, or 12 in the 2026 to 2027 school year who have a deep interest in art or museums.
pay_detail: $1,000 stipend when you finish. MoMA pays for all materials, snacks and other costs.
duration: October 2026 to June 2027, every Tuesday 4:30 to 6:30 PM, plus some other days and weekends.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 deadline was Monday, September 14, 2026, at 11:59 PM. The next cycle is not posted; expect a late summer deadline.
how_to_apply: Online application, linked from the program page when it is open.
notes: Attendance is required. Missing meetings again and again gets you removed. The 2026 to 2027 application form now says it has expired. Questions: momateens@moma.org.
